title: The Pale Protocol Again
author: Elodie Marchetti
blurb: Yara Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
